_readme: Round 8 (item 6): the checked-in allowlist of every declined_cases.json row whose on-device (device) or server (server) outcome knowingly differs from its true outcome (expect), or that is a pinned open defect (defect). Both table tests (app/test/engine/parser/declined_state_cues_table_test.dart, process-ios-sms/parse_test.ts) fail unless the set of deviating rows, with their device/server/defect values, equals this list and count. A completed row may deviate only to a more visible unrecorded outcome (device review / not_completed / transfer; server unresolved / not_completed / review = rejected with the device's own review row), never dropped or ignored, never another amount; another recorded direction only with a defect.
